items.ruleText: Cost 30 gc; Heroes may take them at initial recruitment without a rarity roll; later purchases require a normal rarity roll.

items.name: Forest Cloak
items.ruleText: Heroes only; Rare 10; cost 50 gc. Beside a tree, bush or hedge, shooters suffer an additional -1 BS to hit; a spellcaster must roll 4+ to target the wearer unless within the wearer’s Initiative range.

items.name: Forest Cloak
items.ruleText: Rare 10; beside a tree, bush or hedge, shooters suffer an additional -1 BS to hit; a spellcaster must roll 4+ to target the wearer unless within the wearer's Initiative range.

spellDisciplines.name: Prayers of Sigmar
spellDisciplines.castingRuleSummary: Prayers are not spells; armour may be worn and spell-specific protections do not affect them. The source prayer page does not state a general casting procedure.

spells.name: The Hammer of Sigmar
spells.effectSummary: The wielder gains +2 Strength in close combat and hits cause double damage.

spells.name: Hearts of Steel
spells.effectSummary: Allies within 8 inches ignore Fear and All Alone; the warband gains +1 to Rout tests until the caster is knocked down, stunned or taken out.

spells.name: Soulfire
spells.effectSummary: Enemies within 4 inches take S3 with no armour saves; Undead and Possessed take S5 instead.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.effectSummary: The Priest is immune to spells; roll in Recovery each turn and the shield ends on 1-2.

spells.name: Healing Hand
spells.effectSummary: A model within 2 inches returns to full Wounds; knocked-down or stunned allies in range recover immediately.

spells.name: Armour of Righteousness
spells.effectSummary: The Priest has a 2+ armour save replacing the normal save and causes Fear until the next Shooting phase.

spellAccess.selectionRule: Starts the campaign knowing one Prayer of Sigmar; the warband page does not specify how it is selected.

hiredSwordPolicy.summary: Wolf Priest of Ulric, Norse Shaman and Dark Elf Assassin are explicitly unavailable. Bounty Hunter is also source-prohibited but not catalogued; its prohibition remains a manual restriction without a selectable catalog reference.

specialRules.name: Minimum warband size and budget
specialRules.summary: At least three models; the article says the warband has 500 'points' to assemble, without clarifying whether this means gold crowns.

specialRules.name: City-state selection (manual)
specialRules.summary: The source presents one Tilean warband with Miraglean, Remasen or Trantio rules and skill tables. Select one city-state before applying conditional skills or benefits; no default or separate roster is specified.

specialRules.name: Miraglean rules (conditional)
specialRules.summary: Heroes gain +1 to hit with crossbows; Marksmen gain +1 to hit with any missile weapon; the warband hates Skaven but its Hired Swords do not, and cannot hire Skaven Hired Swords.

specialRules.name: Remasen rules (conditional)
specialRules.summary: When fighting Dark Elves, the player may reroll one Rout test and must accept the second roll; Captain, Champions and Youngbloods have +1 Leadership in all battles; cannot hire Dark Elf Hired Swords.

specialRules.name: Trantio rules (conditional)
specialRules.summary: Adds 100 gc to the starting allowance in a one-off game, or 20% in a Lustrian campaign.

specialRules.name: Henchman groups
specialRules.summary: Henchmen are recruited in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Remasen Leadership (conditional)
specialRules.summary: If the chosen city-state is Remas, the Captain has +1 Leadership.

warriors.name: Champions

specialRules.name: Remasen Leadership (conditional)
specialRules.summary: If the chosen city-state is Remas, each Champion has +1 Leadership.

warriors.conditionText: Apply only the skill categories in the table for the chosen city-state: Miragleans Combat/Shooting/Speed; Remasens Combat/Academic/Strength; Trantios Combat/Speed.

warriors.name: Youngbloods

specialRules.name: Remasen Leadership (conditional)
specialRules.summary: If the chosen city-state is Remas, each Youngblood has +1 Leadership.

warriors.conditionText: Apply only the skill categories in the table for the chosen city-state: Miragleans Shooting/Strength/Speed; Remasens Combat/Academic/Speed; Trantios Combat/Shooting/Strength.

specialRules.name: Miraglean accuracy (conditional)
specialRules.summary: If the chosen city-state is Miragliano, Marksmen gain +1 to hit with any missile weapon.

specialRules.name: Cloak & Dagger
specialRules.summary: Counts as using a buckler in close combat.

items.name: Pike
items.ruleText: Rare 7 special equipment; source recommends the Pike (Merchant Caravans) rules. See special equipment list.

items.name: Hunting Rifle
items.ruleText: The source lists this weapon and its cost but provides no range, Strength or special-rule profile; those details need separate source adjudication.

items.name: Pike (Tileans)
items.ruleText: Rare 7; 3-inch close-combat reach; strikes first in the first round even against a spear, then Initiative order; two-handed and only one attack; cannot use shield or buckler; only man-sized or larger models. Source recommends the Merchant Caravans Pike rules because its Reach rule was removed.

items.name: Rapier
items.ruleText: Rare 5; may parry; after a hit that fails to wound, may continue attacks at -1 to hit until a miss; enemy armour saves improve by +1.

hiredSwordPolicy.summary: Miragleans cannot hire Skaven Hired Swords and Remasens cannot hire Dark Elf Hired Swords. No general whitelist or other city-state restrictions are stated; do not infer unrestricted eligibility, and apply the named exclusions only after city-state selection.

specialRules.name: Parry
specialRules.summary: May parry using the normal sword parry procedure.

specialRules.name: Barrage
specialRules.summary: After a hit that fails to wound, may continue attacking at -1 to hit until an attack misses; required roll cannot worsen beyond 6.

specialRules.name: Armour save
specialRules.summary: The target improves its armour save by +1.

specialRules.name: Strike first
specialRules.summary: Strikes first in the first combat round even against a spear; later rounds use Initiative order.

specialRules.name: Reach
specialRules.summary: May attack an enemy up to 3 inches away without joining its melee; the article recommends the Merchant Caravans Pike rules because Mordheim removed Reach.

specialRules.name: Unwieldy
specialRules.summary: Uses two hands, permits only one attack, and prevents use of a shield or buckler.

specialRules.name: Large
specialRules.summary: Only man-sized or larger models may use it.

specialRules.name: Minimum warband size
specialRules.summary: At least three models; 500 gold crowns are available for recruitment.

specialRules.name: Ostermarker resolve
specialRules.summary: Heroes and Henchmen may reroll a failed Leadership test for being All Alone and a failed Rout test; the second result must be accepted.

specialRules.name: Starting wardog
specialRules.summary: The Captain may have a wardog as part of starting equipment; the Ostermark rule gives no separate price.

specialRules.name: Skill table selection (manual)
specialRules.summary: The Ostermark article has no skill table; it says to choose one of the Reikland, Middenheim or Marienburg Mercenary skill sets. Select one; do not apply that province's other bonuses to Ostermark.

specialRules.name: Henchman groups
specialRules.summary: Henchmen are recruited in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Source grade discrepancy (manual)
specialRules.summary: The catalog indexes Ostermarkers as Grade 1b, but the supplied Mercenaries rules are hosted in the Grade 1a section; retain the indexed grade pending editorial resolution.

warriors.name: Champions
warriors.conditionText: Choose one province's skill table: Reikland gives Combat/Shooting/Strength; Middenheim gives Combat/Strength/Speed; Marienburg gives Combat/Speed.

warriors.name: Youngbloods
warriors.conditionText: Choose one province's skill table: Reikland gives Combat/Shooting/Speed; Middenheim gives Combat/Strength/Speed; Marienburg gives Combat/Speed.

specialRules.name: Expert Swordsmen
specialRules.summary: When charging with a normal sword, may reroll failed hits; does not apply to double-handed swords or other weapons.
